_note: Tier 2, oldest end. Late January 2025: the fourth plague telling, and the third temple session.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is the fourth time the Lord has spoken to him about the virus and that more detail comes each time, recalling the figure of 350 million, obesity as a factor, and the word genocide.
mentions.quote: this is the fourth time he has spoken to me about the virus
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberately released pathogen killing about 350 million.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such release. Undated. The 350 million figure and the obesity comorbidity are the two elements that could be checked against an actual outbreak.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a laboratory scene: a thick yellow liquid like pudding injected into rats, the rats observed for their response, two dying quickly and one surviving longer.
mentions.quote: it was yellow but it looked thick like pudding
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of a rodent-vectored engineered pathogen programme.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such evidence. Undated and with no laboratory or country named.

mentions.claim_text: He says rats will be used because they are more mobile, that he saw them released into cities, and that the pathogen was designed not to kill the carrier quickly so it would spread longer.
mentions.quote: they will use rats they're more mobile
mentions.falsify_match: A deliberate release of infected rodents into cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such release. The delivery mechanism is specific, which makes it checkable if an outbreak is ever investigated.

mentions.claim_text: He says it spread throughout the Middle East, passing Jordan and going into Iraq and Iran before fading, and that the vision did not let him see further.
mentions.quote: it started going into Iraq and Iran but then it kind of faded away
mentions.falsify_match: An outbreak spreading across the Middle East into Iraq and Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states the limit of what he was shown, which is to his credit and also removes the endpoint.

mentions.claim_text: He says all air travel in the United States will be suspended border to border for a period to stop it, and that the euro and the whole European money system collapse first, which triggers the collapse of the dollar and the economy.
mentions.quote: all air travel for a period of time is going to be suspended
mentions.falsify_match: A national suspension of US air travel, and a European monetary collapse that precedes a dollar collapse.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs. The ordering, Europe first and then America, is a real and checkable commitment rather than a general warning.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as it spread across America he saw death everywhere like something out of a horror film, repeats the 350 million figure, and reports the Lord saying that for what they have planned this is a small number.
mentions.quote: I've told you 350 million and the Lord said for what they have planned
mentions.falsify_match: Mass mortality in America on the scale described.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to look at the Black Death, at how many caught it and how many survived, and works out with his wife that it took out almost half the population, giving figures of over a hundred million and fifty million.
mentions.quote: the Lord said I want you to look at the population
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a historical comparison worked out on air.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. The figures are roughly in the accepted range for the fourteenth-century plague, though the arithmetic in the passage is confused.

mentions.claim_text: He retells the Oval Office scene, adding that the man crying for mercy was a different Trump, thinner, tired and worn out, and broken.
mentions.quote: it was a different type of trump he was skinnier
mentions.falsify_match: The president visibly thinner and worn, praying and weeping over the nation.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such account. The physical detail is the checkable part and is new here.

mentions.claim_text: He continues the scene, describing tears and then defibrillator paddles striking the land to shock it awake.
mentions.quote: I saw those hitting the land
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: paddles on the land in vision have no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: He says waves of energy moved across the soil of America during the prayer, and that he was then shown a light like a match up toward the North Pole while black covered the world.
mentions.quote: I saw a light that looked like a match
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: an unexplained light in the Arctic with no event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have time to pray over it and that he always delivers what he is told is coming in order to warn people, then prays protection over the president.
mentions.quote: I always deliver what you tell me is coming to warn the people
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of his own practice, inside a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He says he plans to visit and hear a minister he associates with a named California church, and that he is hungry, alongside what he has seen about the plague.
mentions.quote: I'm just hungry for y'all I'm just hungry

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to fan the flame on YouTube and get people excited about a major harvest of souls, and points to the amount of change in the first week of the new administration.
mentions.quote: he said fan the flame go on YouTube and fan the flame
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an instruction about his own ministry.

mentions.claim_text: He notes reports of a trillion dollar package being discussed with the Saudi crown prince and wonders aloud whether the president knows who he believes the crown prince is.
mentions.quote: I think we can make it a trillion dollar deal
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: commentary on a reported deal, with his standing identification of the crown prince attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed him the third temple in Jerusalem is about to be built, correcting himself that it is built rather than rebuilt, and that Trump will have a major part in bringing the peace accord with Saudi Arabia and other nations.
mentions.quote: the Third Temple is about to be built
mentions.falsify_match: Construction of a third temple in Jerusalem begins, following a US-brokered accord with Saudi Arabia.
mentions.falsify_miss: No construction begins. Undated, but the sequence and the broker are named, and construction would be unmissable.

mentions.claim_text: He distinguishes revival from awakening, saying America needs a spiritual awakening while the church needs revival, and that awakening is the bigger of the two.
mentions.quote: America needs a spiritual awakening but the church needs a Revival

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that Trump will have a hand in the peace accord with Saudi Arabia and Jerusalem so the third temple can be built, and says they have an amazing window of four years.
mentions.quote: bringing in the peace Accord with Saudi Arabia and with Jerusalem
mentions.falsify_match: A US-brokered Saudi-Israel accord that opens the way to temple construction, within the term.
mentions.falsify_miss: None by January 2029. The four-year window is a real endpoint, which is rare in this thread.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told that the window to broadcast freely to the whole world will come to an abrupt end and the door will close, but that for now there is an opportunity to spread the gospel worldwide.
mentions.quote: that window's coming it's going to come to abrupt end
mentions.falsify_match: Online religious broadcasting is shut off or heavily restricted.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Undated, and abrupt end has no threshold, so partial restriction would be read as confirmation.
